description: This Kotlin source file defines an in-memory fallback implementation of a database for a mobile app, providing DAO implementations using in-memory state flows for profiles, connections, and transfer history. It includes classes for DAOs that manage collections of entities with functions for CRUD operations and in-memory clearing.

classes.name: InMemoryAppDatabase
classes.description: In-memory fallback implementation of the AppDatabase, providing DAO methods and a method to clear all tables.

classes.name: InMemoryConnectionDao
classes.description: In-memory implementation of the ConnectionDao interface, managing connection entities with in-memory reactive flows.

classes.name: InMemoryTransferHistoryDao
classes.description: In-memory implementation of the TransferHistoryDao interface, managing transfer history entities with reactive flows.

methods.name: profileDao
methods.description: Returns the DAO implementation for profiles.

methods.name: connectionDao
methods.description: Returns the DAO implementation for connections.

methods.name: transferHistoryDao
methods.description: Provides the DAO implementation for transfer history.

methods.name: clearAllTables
methods.description: Clears all in-memory tables: profiles, connections, transfer history.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all connection entities as a reactive flow, sorted by id descending.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a connection entity by its ID.

methods.name: findByAlias
methods.description: Finds a connection entity by its alias.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a connection entity and returns its ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a connection entity.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a connection entity.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a connection entity by ID.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all connection entities and resets ID counter.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all transfer history entities as a reactive flow, sorted by startedAtMillis descending.

methods.name: getByConnectionId
methods.description: Retrieves transfer history entities for a specific connection ID.

methods.name: getRecent
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent transfer history entities limited by count.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a transfer history entity by ID.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a transfer history entity and returns its ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a transfer history entity.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a transfer history entity.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a transfer history entity by ID.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all transfer history entities and resets ID counter.
